exclusion_rules: any evidence dialog ID absent from the conversation
any evidence dialog turn has an img_url (conservative text-only scope)
exact duplicate (question, category, answer, evidence) within a conversation; retain first eligible occurrence
gold_evidence_policy: Use IDs only in offline scoring; no method may use QA labels or event_summary to segment or rank.
precommitted_primary_metric: question-level all-evidence recall under equal retrieved-text budget
analysis_unit: conversation, with question counts reported as descriptive denominators
note: Phase 1 fixes data eligibility and split. Retrieval budgets and segmentation settings must be frozen on development conversations before held-out runs.
